shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -50

cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && cat .gitignore && echo ---- && find src -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -200; echo ----; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls __agent_eval__ .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts

grep -n -i -A12 "^## .*\(Table\|Navigation\)" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version" 2>/dev/null; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui' package-lock.json; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -5; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{for(const v of JSON.parse(s).reverse()) if(/^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/.test(v)) console.log(v)})' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.' | head -400); do :; done; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@"^7" version peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/table@1.25.0 @bem-react/classname @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable lodash 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -30; npm install --save-dev @types/lodash 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -5; cat package.json

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -40
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo ======; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -250

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/components node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/guides node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/hooks

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; cat $T/package.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const p=JSON.parse(s);console.log(p.main,p.module,p.types,JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,1).slice(0,800))})'; ls $T/build/esm | head; find $T/build/esm -name "index.d.ts" | head

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/index.d.ts $T/components/index.d.ts $T/hooks/index.d.ts | head -120; echo ====; ls $T/components; echo ====; find $T/components/Table -name "*.d.ts" | head;

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/components/Table/Table.d.ts $T/components/SelectionCheckbox/*.d.ts $T/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts $T/constants/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -220; ls $T/constants; cat $T/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.d.ts | head -80

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head -150; echo ====; cat $T/constants/selectionColumn.d.ts $T/hooks/useTable.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ====; cat $T/components/BaseGroupHeader/*.d.ts | head -40; echo ===; cat $T/tanstack.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat $T/../tanstack.d.ts | head -30

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|getGroupTitle" $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js $T/components/BaseRow/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -rln "getIsGroupHeaderRow" $T --include=*.js | head
T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -80; echo ====; cat $T/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js | head -60
T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/constants/selectionColumn.js; cat $T/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js; cat $T/components/SelectionCheckbox/SelectionCheckbox.js | head -40

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; ls $N | head -30; find $N -path "*AsideHeader*" -name "*.d.ts" | grep -v components/ | head; f=$(find $N -name "AsideHeader.d.ts" | head -1); echo $f; cat $f | head -120

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader; ls $N; grep -n "compact\|onChangeCompact\|logo\|menuItems\|renderContent\|AsideHeaderProps\|interface\|MenuItem\b" $N/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ===; grep -n "" $N/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,60p'

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; sed -n '60,160p' $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; echo ===; grep -n "interface MenuItem\|interface LogoProps\|interface MenuGroup" -A22 $N/types.d.ts $N/components/*/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; grep -rn "RenderContentType" $N/components/Content/*.d.ts | head -3

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/components/Content/Content.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "MenuItem\b" -A25 $N/types.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "LogoProps" -A20 $N/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rn "export interface LogoProps" -A20 $N | head -30

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; grep -n "export interface MenuItem" -A25 $N/components/types.d.ts; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls | grep -i -E "^(house|persons?|person|bag|cart|gear|receipt|shopping|dashboard|layout|chart|sliders|ellipsis|users?|clipboard|file)" | grep "\.d\.ts$" | head -60

ls | grep -E "^(Persons?|Person|Bag|Cart|Receipt|ShoppingCart|ShoppingBag|Box|Users|Sliders|Table|Ruble|Circle)[A-Za-z]*\.d\.ts$" | head -60; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep index | head

grep -E "as (Persons|Person|Bag|ShoppingCart|Cart|Receipt|Gear|House|Box|Sliders|Ruble|Users|LayoutCells|ChevronsLeft|Magnifier|ChartColumn|Plus)\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "Persons\|Receipt\|ShoppingCart\|Bag\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; f=$(grep -rl "export interface LabelProps" $U/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo $f; sed -n '1,60p' $f; s=$(grep -rl "export interface SwitchProps" $U/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo $s; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|size\|content" $s | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked" $U/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export interface ButtonProps" -A3 $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "view?" $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export declare const Text\b\|variant" $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "export declare const Flex\|gap" $U/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -4; grep -rn "export declare const Box\|export declare const sp\b" $U/components/Box/*.d.ts $U/components/Box/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null| head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "ControlProps" -A12 $U/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|value" $U/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; grep -rn "ButtonView" $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -2; ls $U/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "export" $U/components/Flex/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3
U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/types.d.ts | head -60; cat $U/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40
U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "ControlProps" -A14 $U/components/types.d.ts | head -30; ls $U/components/layout | head; grep -n "export" $U/components/layout/index.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A3 $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; cat $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts | grep -n "variant\|TextVariant" | head -5

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; grep -n "className\|onClick" $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head; grep -n "ChevronDown\b\|ChevronRight\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; grep -n "onClick\|renderGroupHeader" $T/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; cat $T/components/TreeExpandableCell/TreeExpandableCell.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|AsideHeader'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "AsideHeaderItem" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60

grep -rn "enableColumnReordering" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "enableColumnReordering" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm --include=*.js | head -3
sed -n 1,20p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -60
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25
rm -rf dist && ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(vitest|tsx|vite-node)$"; git status --short
